title: Drugs in Korea and Rudy's overdose
summary: Rudy buys unreliable drugs and nearly dies.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: But anyway, we enjoyed it. We played Seoul and all the other places around there, and Taegu, and then we played a lot of boats and things. We had a lot of problems with drugs over there, though.

Well, Rudy wanted to get high all the time, man. And over there you can get the drugs, but you know, it wasn't very nice, because you didn't ever know what you was getting. You might have been here today and gone tomorrow, according to what the things were. Like a little kid would walk up to you: "Do you want to buy drugs? Do you want to buy my sister? Do you..." Whatever you want, they'll get it for you, but you don't know the quality of what you was getting. Because Rudy had some stuff and he turned green. I said, "Boy, this cat is out." He damn near was gone, man. If it don't be for people know what to do, he would have been gone.
Then, of course, you went to the Philippines...
Yeah. Then we went from there to Okinawa...
